edits.old: Then no event is published and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then no event is published and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC11 Limit read from rwb-decision and no person data (BR7, BR11)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns the rule id, the rule version and the limit in force with its version
    Given the approving user is an identifier and the command holds no person name, address, contact value or identity number
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then the limit and its version are read from rwb-decision only and the step sets no limit
    Then the decision record and the workflow input hold no person data

  Scenario: AC12 Error answers of the provided operation (401, 403, 404)
    Given the caller sends the approval without a valid credential
    When the caller calls the approval operation
    Then the system answers 401 in the platform envelope
    Given the caller does not hold the Treatment and offer right
    When the caller calls the approval operation
    Then the system answers 403 with MSG-P4-002 as in AC3
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not find "RC-2026-000408"
    When the caller calls the approval operation
    Then the system answers 404 in the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC13 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key (BR8, BR18)
    Given an approval is recorded under an Idempotency-Key and its answer is stored
    When the replay arrives with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the stored answer is returned
    Then no second record is written and no second case move is made

  Scenario: AC14 Activity retried or timed out (X7)
    Given the rwb-case call of the approval activity does not answer inside 2 s
    When the workflow retries the activity
    Then the retry follows the workflow schedule
    Then no record is written twice and no second case move is made

  Scenario: AC15 Consumed call fails (X7)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock fails the call
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then nothing is written
    Then the caller sees 503 in the platform envelope

  Scenario: AC16 Status change the model does not allow (X6)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the case state "ROUTE_D6" for "RC-2026-000408" and the chosen route is not an allowed move from that state
    When the user acts on the screen
    Then the move is refused
    Then nothing is written and no case move is made
